workholding.reasoning: Part size (152.4×88.9mm) fits comfortably in a standard 6-inch vise (typical jaw opening 0-150mm). Full perimeter accessible for contouring and slotting. No internal features compromise rigidity. Parallels provide 10-12mm clearance for through-hole drilling and through-slot cutting. Part thickness (9.5mm) allows adequate clamping force without distortion.
alternatives: Soft jaws (recommended for 25-part production) — custom machined to part profile, reduces setup time per part, better positional repeatability
Tombstone fixture (for unattended lights-out production) — multiple parts per setup
Vacuum table (if surface finish priority) — eliminates vise jaw marks, preferred for thin plates
workholding.setup_notes: Single setup sufficient: all operations accessible from top side. Through-holes and through-slot achievable with parallels providing clearance below part. No second operation required. Recommended: probe workpiece for Z-zero and corner offset before starting cycle.
workholding.clamping_force_note: Vise clamping force should be moderate (500-800 N) to avoid distorting 9.5mm plate. Clamp on 152.4mm dimension for maximum rigidity. Center part in vise jaws.

checks_passed: One setup expected — all features accessible from top
Pocket corner radius compatible with selected cutter
Slot width accommodates standard end mill
Hole spacing manufacturable (≥2× hole diameter from edges and other holes)
No trapped tools or inaccessible features
potential_improvements: ±0.005" (0.127mm) tolerance appears tighter than necessary for a mounting plate with standard features. Relaxing to ±0.010" could reduce machining time and cost by ~10-15% while maintaining functional requirements.
Pocket corner radius (3.175mm / 0.125") is tight. Increasing to 4.76mm (3/16") would allow using a 3/8" end mill for faster material removal (2.8× more volume per pass).
Slot width (6.35mm / 0.250") could be specified at 6.0mm to use a single 6mm end mill for both pocket and slot operations without dedicated finish pass — reducing one tool change.
questions_raised: Preferred machine type? (3-axis VMC with CAT40 spindle assumed in CAM plan)

Inspection method and AQL? (CMM, pin gauges, or go/no-go for hole positions?)
Thread requirements? (4× Ø6.53mm through-holes — tapped? If so, thread spec needed)

Edge break specification? (0.005" max chamfer or per internal standard?)
